name: Capital A Berhad
overview: 2026年，Capital A Berhad 的主要业务动态集中在集团层面：公司于5月19日宣布解除 PN17 财务困境状态；同时，其全资子公司 AAD Holdings Inc. 完成成员自愿清算并解散。此外，公司持续进行股份分拆/附加上市，并有多项关于提供财务援助的公告。
overview_en: In 2026, Capital A Berhad's key business developments were at the group level: the company announced the upliftment of its PN17 status on 19 May; meanwhile, its wholly-owned subsidiary AAD Holdings Inc. completed a members' voluntary liquidation and was dissolved. Additionally, the company continued with share subdivision/additional listings and made several announcements on the provision of financial assistance.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 集团层面今年主要事项包括解除 PN17 状态、子公司清算解散以及持续的股份分拆/附加上市。
segments.note_en: At the group level, key matters this year include the upliftment of PN17 status, the liquidation and dissolution of a subsidiary, and ongoing share subdivision/additional listings.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: AAD Holdings Inc. 的清算已完成，并于2026年11月18日收到解散证书，不再为子公司。
actions.text_en: The liquidation of AAD Holdings Inc. was completed, with the Certificate of Dissolution received on 18 November 2026, and it ceased to be a subsidiary.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 AAD Holdings Inc. 启动成员自愿清算程序。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary AAD Holdings Inc. commenced members' voluntary liquidation proceedings.

actions.title: CAPITAL A BERHAD - UPLIFTMENT OF PN17 STATUS
actions.text: 公司于2026年5月19日宣布解除 PN17 财务困境状态。
actions.text_en: The company announced the upliftment of its PN17 status on 19 May 2026.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 通过清算解散全资子公司 AAD Holdings Inc.，退出该实体。
model_changes.text_en: Exited the entity AAD Holdings Inc. through liquidation and dissolution of the wholly-owned subsidiary.
